questions.question: LIFECYCLE-1 — default retention when the operator sets nothing?
options: Messages 90 days, memory until offboarding, audit 400 days minimum (Recommended)
Messages 30 days, memory 90 days, audit 1 year
questions.chosen: Messages 90 days, memory until offboarding, audit 400 days minimum (Recommended)

questions.question: INTRO-1 — when does the intro card post in a channel?
options: Once, on install, plus on first @mention by any new person (Recommended)
On install and pinned; DM everyone in the channel
questions.chosen: Once, on install, plus on first @mention by any new person (Recommended)

questions.question: REVISION-1 — who can restore a prior persona/access revision?
options: Owner for persona; administrator for access (Recommended)
questions.chosen: Owner for persona; administrator for access (Recommended)

questions.question: Anything else to settle before I confirm these eleven specs and open the PR?
options: No — confirm and open the PR (Recommended)
Hold — I want to change something first
questions.chosen: No — confirm and open the PR (Recommended)
